name: BARTEC Pixavi Phone
statusNote: Discontinued by BARTEC. The SP9EX1 replaces it.
summary: The BARTEC Pixavi Phone is an intrinsically safe (Ex ib) smartphone from BARTEC, certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX and IECEx. It runs Android 11, with a user-replaceable battery. It has been discontinued; the BARTEC SP9EX1 replaces it.

otherSchemes: INMETRO (Brazil) UL-BR 22.1400X, Ex ib IIC T4 Gb / Ex ib IIIC T135°C Db, valid to 2028-08-30

atex.marking: II 2G Ex ib IIC T4 Gb / II 2D Ex ib IIIC T135°C Db

iecex.marking: Ex ib IIC T4 Gb / Ex ib IIIC T135°C Db

certification.northAmerica: NEC 505: Class I, Zone 0, AEx ia IIC T4 Ga (cert. 22CA80042090X); datasheet text also says NEC Class I Div 1; US version 17-S133-1211/11112000 only

safety.conditions: Specific conditions of use (CSANe 20ATEX4223X / IECEx SIR 20.0036X): USB port only for charging in the non-hazardous area, with BARTEC charger G7-S0Z0-0001 to -0004 or other BARTEC-approved accessories (Um 12 V); ambient temperature during charging 0 to 45 °C; USB data port assessed for Um 12 V (install per IEC/EN 60079-14); avoid drop and impact (aluminium in enclosure); no prolific charge-generating processes; check battery pack surfaces regularly and replace only with type 17-S1Z0-0001; do not remove the battery pack in the hazardous area. Original BARTEC accessories only.
